notes_for_editor: One list entry (tnlandforms.us, map dated March 2016) is the only source for this tower. Its name matches Kings Bay Base, a Navy submarine base, but no source places the tower on or off the base, so the base is not treated as its location. The list gives elevation 40 with no unit label, so it is left out. Neither NHLR nor the former-sites register lists it (absence checked against the full Georgia lists). Two WebSearch queries, plus Georgia Forestry Commission pages that timed out or refused connection, produced nothing on this tower. The brief's status and access stay unknown; none of the sources support a status, height, design or access level.
